caption: A round-bottomed roly-poly toy on a table is pushed over onto its side and let go, and it rocks back upright and settles.

sa.check: A round-bottomed roly-poly toy is on a table.
It is pushed over onto its side and let go.
The release comes first, then the rocking, then the settling.

pc.expect: It swings back toward upright as soon as it is released, rocks with shrinking swings, and ends standing.
pc.fail: It stays on its side; or tips over the other way; or the swings grow.

pc.expect: Nothing touches it after the release.
pc.fail: It is pushed again; or slides; or restarts after settling.
It floats; or lifts; or sinks.
It squashes; or melts; or splits.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The toy's colours and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The toy changes colour; or the table changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The hand is kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
